newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.169pts to 103.327.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.169pts to 103.327.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.169 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.327, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.059 points to 2.198 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.154 points to 99.631, points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.193 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 lost 7.488 points to 1,030.396.
